en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 10. And with the preceding chains of narration from ‘Ali ibn Mahzyar, from al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Husayn ibn Mas’ab, from Sa’d ibn Turaif, from: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, peace be upon both, who said:
"Soften your speech with [even] the hypocrite, love the faithful believer sincerely, and [even] if a Jew were to sit with you, then be gracious in his company."
